misprints.note: The print has no accent on the continuation of συγκε-|ραννυναι.
The article is printed with a smooth breathing.
The full stop is doubled in the print.

uncertain.note: The point before the colon is raised, almost a Greek ano teleia. I transcribed it as the book's usual ".:".
The mark over ω is small and could be grave+breathing or a circumflex. I read it as ὢν.
The breathing on ἡ is malformed and looks almost like smooth+grave. I read it as ἡ.
ἀνήνοτα is clearly what is printed. It may be a deliberate variant and not a misprint, so I kept it as it is.
